proposition: Ibn Turka's full name and forms of address: Ṣāʾin al-Dīn Abū Muḥammad ʿAlī b. Afżal al-Dīn Muḥammad b. Ṣadr al-Dīn Abī Ḥāmid Muḥammad Turka Iṣfahānī Khujandī; he uses the takhalluṣ ʿAlī in his verse, usually signs letters Ṣāyin-i Turka, and in one reading note calls himself ʿAlī b. Muḥammad b. Muḥammad Turka.

mediation.who: reading note, MS Majlis 10196 f. 330a, and his signatures, as reported by MK
